UPDATE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Archive
SET ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Archive.FullName = B.Fullname
FROM reconcontrol.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Archive A
Join reconcontrol.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReportAnalysts_Mapping B
ON A.CreatedBy = B.CreatedBy 
WHERE A.FullName is null OR A.FullName = ''

UPDATE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging
SET ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.LastUpdateTime = cast (LastUpdateTime as date)
FROM ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging

UPDATE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging
SET ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.CreationTime = cast (CreationTime as date)
FROM ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging

UPDATE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging
SET ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.TradeRelationship =
CASE WHEN tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.LinkedTradeType = 'C-SWNG'
Then 'CHILD' ELSE 'PARENT' END

UPDATE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging
SET ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.CancelledWhen = 'SameDayCancel'
FROM ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging
JOIN [dbo].[vw_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_CXL]
ON [dbo].[vw_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_CXL].TicketId = ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.TicketId
WHERE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.EventType = 'NEW'
AND ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.parentid = [dbo].[vw_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_CXL].ParentId 
and Cast (ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.CreationTime as date) = cast ([dbo].[vw_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_CXL].LastupdateTime as date)

UPDATE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging
SET ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.Trading_Unit_Name = B.Trading_Unit_Name
FROM ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging A
JOIN ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_IM_GENERIC_ALLSTATUS_Mapping B 
ON A.Book = B.Inventory_Name
WHERE B.STATUS = 'Active'

UPDATE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging
SET ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.FullName = ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReportAnalysts_Mapping.FullName
FROM ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging
JOIN ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReportAnalysts_Mapping
ON [dbo].tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.CreatedBy = ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReportAnalysts_Mapping.CreatedBy
WHERE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.FullName is null OR ReconControl.dbo.tbl_GSF_Daily_WFSIWFBNReport_Staging.FullName = ''
